title: Patch: an art bible and scene kits: each set's look written down, pictures composed as scenes, and more detail the rarer the card
notes: The foundation of #3330's per-set picture passes. ART.md gains an art bible: each set family's home, palette in palette.css names, light, line, camera and what each rarity adds. A card's picture can now be composed as a scene from a recipe of seven layers of kit parts (sceneRecipes.ts, sceneKit.ts, figureKit.ts: 86 parts, a figure kit of poses, heads, headgear, outfits by tag and held items), seeded by its id, the Radiant face repainting the same shapes (R3331000). Five proof cards draw from recipes: Corpse Plantation (Classic #74), Speciesist (Core #2), Heroic Power (Core #98), Ceaseless Void (Core #100) and Arg Arg Defender (Stinkyscape #15); every other card's picture is byte for byte unchanged. A detail floor per rarity (Common 30 drawn elements up to Mythic 140) starts as a ratchet of the 563 cards under it today, under a 48 KiB ceiling per picture (R3331001). R503's pin on Core's v0.1 pictures is lifted by the owner's decision of 2026-11-06: the three golden fixtures are records, holding every card with no recipe (R3331002). How cards look only: nothing plays differently.

player.title: Richer card pictures, starting with five
changes: Five cards now show a picture composed as a whole scene, more detailed the rarer the card: Corpse Plantation, Speciesist, Heroic Power, Ceaseless Void and Arg Arg Defender.
Every other card keeps its picture for now. Each set's pictures, Core's included, are redrawn as scenes in the patches to come.
